# netbox_vpn_tunnels (Data Source)

Lists vpn_tunnel objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_vpn_tunnels" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-vpn_tunnel" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `vpn_tunnels` (Attributes List) The matching vpn_tunnels. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpn_tunnels))

<a id="nestedatt--vpn_tunnels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpn_tunnels`

Read-Only:

- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. An object field holds the related object's id, e.g. "12", a multiobject field a JSON list of ids in any order, e.g. jsonencode([12, 13]). A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `encapsulation` (String) Tunnel encapsulation protocol. One of: ipsec-transport, ipsec-tunnel, ip-ip, gre, wireguard, openvpn, l2tp, pptp.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `ipsec_profile_id` (Number) Id of the IPsec profile.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `status` (String) Operational status. One of: planned, active, disabled.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `tenant_id` (Number) Id of the tenant.
- `termination_count` (Number) Number of terminations of the tunnel.
- `tunnel_group_id` (Number, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of vpn_tunnel_group_id.
- `tunnel_id` (Number) Numeric tunnel identifier on the wire (e.g. a GRE key), not the NetBox id.
- `url` (String)
- `vpn_tunnel_group_id` (Number) Id of the tunnel group.
